run_agent_cli: run the CLI agent with an optional agent path to start an interactive AI agent loop
run_agent_async: run the async agent loop with an optional agent path for interactive tool use
run_cli_callback: run the typer CLI callback that invokes the agent with a path argument
load_agent_config: load agent configuration and prompt from a local folder or Hugging Face dataset
patch_anyio_open_process: patch anyio open process to prevent stdio connections from being stopped by Ctrl+C
